name: max_connections
description: Determines the maximum number of concurrent connections to the database server.
symptoms: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
tuning_tips: Do not set this too high. Each connection uses memory (work_mem, etc.) and OS resources. For high concurrency, use a connection pooler (like PgBouncer) instead of raising this limit directly.
official_snippet: Defining this parameter effectively defines the maximum number of backend processes that can run simultaneously.
